profilePrivacyNote: This information is private to your account, never shown to anyone else, and never included in site-wide statistics. It's used only to personalize your own recipe suggestions — filtering out allergens and flagging recipes that may need extra caution. You can clear it at any time.
profileCycleHelp: Used only to gently prioritize women's health recipes around your estimated period — not a full cycle tracker or medical prediction.
profileAllergiesHelp: Recipes containing any of these are excluded from suggestions entirely.
profileConcernsHelp: Recipes with a matching safety caution are still shown, but flagged so you can decide for yourself.
